title: Large-scale iontronic skins with neural-hierarchical processing architecture
title_zh: 大规模神经层次处理架构离子电子皮肤
abstract: Abstract The human skin gathers and encodes signals from over 200,000 mechanoreceptors, enabling high-spatiotemporal-resolution tactile perception and instant injury prevention. Existing skin-like sensor arrays often have limited sensor count and density, and they use a serial readout architecture that suffers from readout latency, signal crosstalk and bandwidth consumption as element density increases. Here we report a high-density (1,110 units cm ‒2 ) and large-scale (>10,000 units) neural-hierarchical iontronic skin that mimics the hierarchical processing architecture of the human sensory system, which transmits interactive information in layers via signal encoding, convergence and cognitive modelling. Frequency-based position encoding of iontronic sensors enables parallel signal transmission with suppressed crosstalk and a rate of 100 frames per second, while backend convergent compression decreases bandwidth consumption by hundreds of times. We demonstrate that humanoid robots equipped with neural-hierarchical iontronic skins can perform challenging tasks, including fine tactile interactions that can resolve surface features of 300 µm, and the perception of nociceptive stimuli for self-protective responses. This technology provides a large-scale tactile system with high spatiotemporal resolution, paving the way for humanoid robots to approach human-level perception and manipulation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 人类皮肤从200,000多个机械受体获取并编码信号，实现高空间时间分辨率的触觉感知和即时伤害预防。现有的类似皮肤的传感器阵列通常传感器数量和密度有限，且采用串行读出架构，随着元件密度增加，会出现读出延迟、信号串扰和带宽消耗等问题。本文报道了一种高密度（1,110个单位/平方厘米）且大规模（>10,000个单位）的神经层次离子电子皮肤，其模仿人类感觉系统的层次处理架构，通过信号编码、汇聚和认知建模在层间传输交互信息。离子电子传感器的基于频率的位置编码实现了并行信号传输，抑制了串扰，传输速率达100帧/秒，而后端的汇聚压缩使带宽消耗减少了数百倍。我们展示了配备神经层次离子电子皮肤的类人机器人能够执行具有挑战性的任务，包括能够分辨300微米表面特征的精细触觉交互，以及 nociceptive stimuli（ nociceptive stimuli）的感知以实现自我保护响应。该技术为大规模高空间时间分辨率触觉系统提供了可能，有助于类人机器人接近人类水平的感知和操作。
